mode: Read-only source audit; no new browser tests
decision: Do not integrate V3 before removed-unit, print-active and server-added-call-level signature cases are resolved.

findings.finding: Print snapshot restores captured old posting nodes after a fresh readback replaces rows.
findings.source: unit-board-filters.ts startPrint stores nodes; refreshReadback calls apply without retiring restorePrint; finishPrint later restores old nodes.
findings.direction: Finish owned prior print materialization before fresh table/card update, apply fresh data, then start a fresh print materialization if print media remains active. Preserve filter/page/focus ownership and no additional listeners.

findings.finding: Missing returned unit silently skips modal refresh; helper still announces saved and refreshed.
findings.source: refreshUnitModalReadback returns on !unit; helper refresh continuation then updates status/refreshed callback.
findings.direction: Explicit retained-draft unavailable notice/native validity blocks save; report incomplete dependent context through recoverable error and GET-only retry. Clear notice/bounds when unit returns.

findings.finding: Server-added call-level inputs alter signature used by helper hasNewDraft even when user made no edits.
findings.source: refreshUnitModalReadback appends new input rows during options.commit; helper compares dynamic signature immediately afterwards.
findings.direction: Distinguish returned topology changes from user edits; avoid falsely claiming unsaved user changes. If review is intentionally required, state topology changed rather than claiming user draft.

findings.finding: A focused header previous/next button can become disabled before active focus is captured.
findings.source: refreshUnitModalReadback disables navigation then captures document.activeElement.
findings.direction: Capture ownership before header changes; restore only owned displaced focus to a matching control or status, never steal focus from another dialog/input.

positive_checks: WeakMap refresher reuses existing listeners rather than binding more during readback. Cleanup deletes only the matching current refresher; old root observers cannot delete a new binding.
Existing settings form and numeric input nodes/values are retained. Returned max/context updates and removed-call validity messages are scoped to exact data-unit-call-minimum identity.
Validation/member action replacements match exact data attributes for focus recovery; background board filters preserve search/campus and clamp page through existing apply.
limits: Source findings need new candidate/runtime proof; no blanket backend or print export-content change is authorized.
